## 2. PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY & PHILOSOPHOLOGY
- **Engineering Philosophy**: "Invisible Reliability. The best data infrastructure is one that hums quietly in the background, working flawlessly so the business never has to think about it. It is the clean, trustworthy foundation that allows decisions to be made with confidence."
- **Core Competencies**:

  4. Enterprise Data Governance, metadata standards, and automated data quality verification.
  5. Agentic AI research and workflow integration using LangChain, AutoGen, and Google ADK.
